insert into collect_interface_statistics ( task_id, interface_id, statistics_time, collection_count, interface_rate, is_deleted ) values
( #{record.taskId}, #{record.interfaceId}, #{record.statisticsTime}, #{record.collectionCount}, #{record.interfaceRate}, 0 )
on conflict (task_id, interface_id, statistics_time) do update set
collection_count = greatest(collect_interface_statistics.collection_count, excluded.collection_count), interface_rate = excluded.interface_rate, is_deleted = 0

insert into data_processing_statistics ( task_id, interface_id, statistics_time, processing_count, duplicate_count, wild_value_count, is_deleted ) values
( #{record.taskId}, #{record.interfaceId}, #{record.statisticsTime}, #{record.processingCount}, #{record.duplicateCount}, #{record.wildValueCount}, 0 )
on conflict (task_id, interface_id, statistics_time) do update set processing_count = excluded.processing_count, duplicate_count = excluded.duplicate_count, wild_value_count = excluded.wild_value_count, is_deleted = 0
